content.text:
I'm looking at the X shape spanning rows 6-8, cols 4-6, with a small marker 6 at (5,3) indicating an up-left diagonal direction. I'm figuring out the step size by matching the example, where the shape copy shifted by exactly its own height/width along that diagonal.

With step 3, I'm computing copies at (-3,-3) and (-6,-6) offsets: the first lands at rows3-5/cols1-3, the second at rows0-2/cols-2-0 (clipping negative columns, leaving just two cells visible). Further copies go off-grid so I stop there, painting all these cells color 6 like the original marker.
